live_collector_transport: Public body fetched via urllib inherited proxy; passed to actual collectFlPublic/getText with status, content type and byte limit checks; no raw page persisted
scope: Public aggregate source feasibility; no account, messages, personal contacts, or CRM records

platforms.name: FL.ru
platforms.robots: Public first-page HTML paths allowed; */rss/*, /api/, login and many query paths disallowed. RSS not fetched during this study.
platforms.terms: Main agreement and appendix checked. No crawler/data-extraction prohibition found. Appendix prohibits disruption, spam and bypass of technical restrictions. This is limited policy evidence, not explicit crawler authorization.
platforms.free_reply: Official listing FAQ: orders bearing «для всех», all vacancies and all contests have free responses. PRO not required. All other orders require a paid response package.
platforms.requirements: Registration and identity verification. No paid subscription required for qualifying order response. Manual response only.
platforms.timestamp_evidence: Live first-page web order published «08.10.2026 в 10:30» and relative 10–20 minutes ago during checks. That order lacked a free badge and was excluded.
platforms.adapter: Strict bounded public HTML parser; per-card header badge only; type Заказ only; genuine web tasks only. Relative minutes/hours anchored to observation time; zoned datetime preserved; unknown time null.
platforms.integration_status: Technically useful for conditional monitoring, 15-minute first-page checks, 1MiB hard bound. Tested live parser returned zero eligible records. Do not promise a fresh free order stream or enable RSS.

platforms.name: Freelance.ru
platforms.freshness: Newest general postings 15–18 minutes old, visible web landing-page task about 2 hours old.
platforms.evidence: Rules §9.1: «Базовый аккаунт при регистрации ... при условии приобретения пользователем пакета откликов на задания». «Видно всем» is visibility, not free response eligibility.
platforms.policy: Basic replies require payment; automatic/mass template responses banned; robots blocks pagination and filter paths.
platforms.integration_status: Exclude from zero-ruble required-cost reply pool.

platforms.name: Kwork
platforms.free_reply: Official FAQ: one connect per proposal; connects provided free monthly based on seller level and cannot be purchased. An individual account's available allowance was not checked.
platforms.policy: Terms explicitly prohibit robots/software/requests used to monitor, extract, copy or collect service data. No automated collector, even where robots path is not disallowed.
platforms.integration_status: Manual candidate only if seller registration and free connect entitlement are satisfied; no anonymous verified last-hour project feed.

platforms.name: Weblancer
platforms.free_reply: 10-day free trial after uploading photograph and 200-character resume; ongoing free entitlement not established. Agreement points to tariffs and success commission.
platforms.freshness: Date-only listing includes 08.10.2026; no verified last-hour publication time.
platforms.policy: Robots blocks /api/, /ajax/, /account/ and query variants; do not fetch protected tariff page.
platforms.integration_status: No sustained zero-ruble integration established; manual time-limited trial only.

platforms.name: Habr Freelance
platforms.integration_status: Blocked for automatic collection. No tasks or RSS requested after robots denial.

platforms.name: Searchengines.guru
platforms.timestamp_caveat: RSS pubDate represents original thread date (often years old); feed ordering includes updated discussions. Channel build date is not publication time.
platforms.policy: Terms §3.7 explicitly prohibit automated access including scripts and scanners; §3.9 restricts copying. Stop automatic collection despite working RSS.
platforms.integration_status: Manual forum research only; no authorized automatic integration.

platforms.name: CyberForum
platforms.policy: Robots permits feed; crawl-delay1. Forum requires membership in Freelancers group to view/execute orders. No membership or account action attempted.
platforms.integration_status: Empty anonymous order RSS; free membership/reply eligibility not verified. No usable public stream.

platforms.name: Pchel.net
platforms.free_reply: Official support: Standard accounts 100 free applications/responses per month; PRO optional.
platforms.freshness: Two web orders from first page show «Создан: 2 года назад» and «Создан: 5 лет назад». No first-page last-hour task verified. Relative activity timestamps are not publication dates.
platforms.policy: First-page jobs path not disallowed; checked rules contain no automated-access prohibition. No RSS discovered.
platforms.integration_status: Free-response route confirmed, freshness fails; do not integrate as newest-orders feed.

platforms.name: Freelancehunt
platforms.policy: Robots allows RSS, reserves no AI training. One successful rules load did not establish free allowance or Russian account eligibility; later403 not bypassed or retried.
platforms.integration_status: Technically strongest actual recent RSS candidate, but zero-cost response and Russian eligibility unproven. Leave disabled pending official verification.

platforms.name: Other boards
platforms.policy: Freelancejob robots notice prohibits automated collection except search indexing/AI RAG or written permission; lead harvesting is not those exceptions. Maultalk root yielded only domain title. SQL503 not bypassed.
